title: Towards Socially Responsible AI: Cognitive Bias-Aware Multi-Objective Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a multi-objective learning framework to mitigate social biases, specifically gender and race, within emotion classification tasks. While it discusses the overarching goal of making AI 'ethically correct' and mentions religion as a dimension of social discrimination, it does not include a component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral frameworks.
